name: Alexandria
type: city; municipality; polis; big city; port city
text: Alexandria is a major city in Egypt. Lying at the western edge of the Nile River Delta, it extends about 40 km (25 mi) along the country's northern coast. It is Egypt's principal seaport, the second largest city after Cairo, and the largest city on the Mediterranean coast.

depictions.name: Alexandria
depictions.text: Alexandria is the second largest city of Egypt, located along its northern coastline near the Mediterranean Sea. It is named after the Macedonian king Alexander the Great, who founded the city around 331 BCE. A Hellenistic city, Alexandria served as the capital of Egypt throughout the Ptolemaic dynasty.
